paper: CO-SPY: Combining Semantic and Pixel Features to Detect Synthetic Images by AI (Cheng, Lyu, Wang, Zhang, Sehwag — CVPR 2025)
training_set_in_paper: Two checkpoints. (a) DRCT-2M / Stable-Diffusion-v1.4: 236k images = SD-v1.4 synthetics from MSCOCO captions + equal MSCOCO reals (paper Sec. Experiments / Implementation; README data/train/sd-v1_4). Used for Co-Spy-Bench + GenImage. (b) CNNDet / ProGAN (LSUN): 720k images = 20 categories x 18k ProGAN fakes + equal LSUN reals (README data/train/progan). Used for AIGCDetectionBenchmark + ForenSynths.

benchmarks.name: Co-Spy-Bench
subsets_or_generators: 22 generative models x 5 real-caption sources = the paper's main table; AGID materializes 110 (dataset x generator) cells. Generators: ldm-text2im-large-256, SD-v1-4, SD-v1-5, SSD-1B, tiny-sd, SegMoE-SD-4x2, small-sd, SD-2-1, SD-3-medium, sdxl-turbo, SD-2, SDXL-base-1.0, playground-v2.5-1024, playground-v2-1024, playground-v2-512, playground-v2-256, PixArt-XL-2-1024, PixArt-XL-2-512, lcm-lora-sdxl, lcm-lora-sdv1-5, FLUX.1-schnell, FLUX.1-dev

paper_per_generator.note: Paper Table 2 reports per-source averages; README (Issue #7 reproduction) gives per-source AP averages CC3M 89.39 / FLICKR 99.46 / MSCOCO 99.40 / TEXTCAPS 96.52 / SBU 98.50, mean AP ~96.7; acc CC3M 82.22 / FLICKR 91.24 / MSCOCO 92.24 / TEXTCAPS 89.20 / SBU 84.34

benchmarks.official_eval_protocol: sd-v1_4 fusion checkpoint (semantic+artifact+fusion). dataSets/dataset.py CoSpyBenchTestDataset using model.test_transform (semantic branch CLIP-style resize/center-crop 224 + CLIP-normalize; artifact branch its own preprocessing). JPEG compression q75-95 applied to test images (paper). Metric = sklearn average_precision (utils.evaluate). main.py --phase eval --train_dataset sd-v1_4 --pretrain.

our_number.ckpt: checkpoints_retrain/cospy_full/model_1.pth (AGID retrain, full SD-v1.4 data, flickr-reals bug fixed)

benchmarks.gap_cause: Reproduced and BEATS official-weights-in-AGID (86.65). Earlier AGID checkpoint (72.81) was below due to a deleted-reals/wrong-flickr-source data bug; after the full-SD-v1.4 retrain it matches paper 96.0.
benchmarks.dataset_source: on-disk /hddstore/ssalehi/AGID/CoSpyBench/test (110 gen x dataset cells). Origin: HF datasets/ruojiruoli/Co-Spy-Bench (download via data/test/Co-Spy-Bench/download.py).

benchmarks.name: AIGCDetectionBenchmark (AIGCDetect)
subsets_or_generators: 16 generators in README/Table-8 list: ADM, biggan, cyclegan, DALLE2, gaugan, Glide, Midjourney, progan, SD-v1.4, SD-v1.5, stargan, stylegan, stylegan2, VQDM, whichfaceisreal, wukong. AGID adds sd_xl -> 17 cells.

paper_per_generator.note: README Table-8 (Appendix K) per-generator AP: progan 100, cyclegan 99.47, stargan 99.98, stylegan2 99.85, stylegan 99.69, gaugan 98.24, biggan 98.00, DALLE2 97.14, Glide 96.71, Midjourney 94.55, SD-v1.4 92.99, SD-v1.5 92.96, VQDM 91.96, ADM 89.98, wukong 89.59, whichfaceisreal 82.27; avg AP 95.21 / acc 90.58

benchmarks.official_eval_protocol: progan (CNNDet/ProGAN) fusion checkpoint. AIGCDetectTestDataset, JPEG-compressed test images, average_precision. main.py --phase eval --train_dataset progan --pretrain.

our_number.ckpt: official ProGAN weights loaded into AGID class (/hddstore/ssalehi/AGID/repro/ckpts/progan)

benchmarks.gap_cause: Official-weights-in-AGID reproduces (94.59 vs paper 95.21). The AGID *from-scratch* checkpoint trails (84.91) on the non-SD adm/vqdm/biggan GAN generators because it is the SD-v1.4-trained Co-Spy, not the ProGAN-trained one; the cross-generator gap is the residual retrain target.

benchmarks.name: GenImage
subsets_or_generators: 8 generators: adm, biggan, glide, midjourney, sdv1.4, sdv1.5, vqdm, wukong

paper_number.note: Co-Spy paper references GenImage qualitatively (Appendix L) and claims it outperforms baselines; no clean single headline mAP for the SD-v1.4 checkpoint is tabulated in the main paper. Treated as a secondary/cross-dataset benchmark.

benchmarks.official_eval_protocol: sd-v1_4 fusion checkpoint, GenImage 8-generator test, average_precision; same Co-Spy test transform as Co-Spy-Bench.
benchmarks.gap_cause: AGID retrain (90.59) below official-weights-in-AGID (92.41) by ~1.8 mAP, concentrated on non-SD generators adm/biggan/vqdm (fake_acc collapses: official wts adm fake_acc 9.6, biggan 22.3). The SD-v1.4-trained Co-Spy generalizes weakly to GAN/ADM generators; this is a cross-generator transfer gap, not a code defect.

benchmarks.name: ForenSynths (CNNDetection test)

paper_number.note: Not a headline Co-Spy table; reported here as an AGID cross-reference benchmark (Co-Spy inherits CNNDet ProGAN training from prior work).

benchmarks.gap_cause: AGID retrain (96.17) beats official-weights-in-AGID (87.97) on ForenSynths-13; no gap.

benchmarks.name: In-the-wild (Co-Spy-Bench in-the-wild)

paper_number.note: Paper Table 3 in-the-wild evaluation; Co-Spy ~14% higher acc than best baseline. ~50k in-the-wild synthetics.

benchmarks.official_eval_protocol: sd-v1_4 fusion checkpoint; same Co-Spy test transform; average_precision/accuracy over the 5 in-the-wild sources. No resize beyond the per-branch test transforms.
benchmarks.gap_cause: Dataset NOT on disk and not reproducible end-to-end. /hddstore/.../Co-Spy/data/in_the_wild/ contains only README.md + urls/ (flux.txt, lexica.txt). Per the official README & Issue #6, several samples (instavibe.ai) are deliberately NOT redistributed for IP reasons; sources (1),(2),(5) are downloadable but the curated 50k set itself is not released as a single artifact.
benchmarks.dataset_source: gated / url-list only. Downloadable parts: Civitai (civitai.com), DALL-E 3 (HF ProGamerGov/synthetic-dataset-1m-dalle3-high-quality-captions), Midjourney-v6 (HF terminusresearch/midjourney-v6-520k-raw); instavibe.ai + Lexica only via data/in_the_wild/urls/*.txt; the exact curated split is not released (Co-Spy GitHub Issue #6).
